name: RCP pipeline has stopped ingesting results
summary: No probe results were stored in five minutes while monitors are enabled.
description: Check result-consumer errors, job publication and the two regional Lambdas. Startup has a five-minute grace period; disabled monitors do not trigger this rule. With the pending period and ingestion delay, delivery is usually around six minutes.

name: RCP app metrics are missing or stale
expr: max(max(up{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"} == bool 0) or absent(up{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"}) or absent(rcp_probe_results_stored_total{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"}) or absent(rcp_system_monitors_enabled{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"}) or absent(process_start_time_seconds{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"}) or absent(rcp_system_metrics_last_success_epoch_seconds{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"}) or ((time() - rcp_system_metrics_last_success_epoch_seconds{job="rcp-app",project="rcp",environment="demo"}) > bool 120))
summary: The app scrape failed, an expected metric disappeared, or database metrics stopped refreshing.
description: Check Alloy, its remote-write token and the private management listener. If the VM is gone, use the external API alert and restore an off-host backup.

name: RCP dashboard is unavailable
summary: An external location cannot get HTTP 200 over HTTPS from the dashboard.
description: Inspect the Synthetic Monitoring check history and CloudFront/S3. This checks page delivery, not JavaScript execution or sign-in.

name: RCP API is unavailable
summary: An external location cannot get UP from the API readiness route.
description: Check DuckDNS, HTTPS, Caddy, the control plane and PostgreSQL. This check and its alert run outside the Oracle VM. The scheduled /drill/status.html outage should not trigger this rule.
